7229.title: Sidebar paint/hit-test investigation
7229.rootCauseOneLine: Root cause is unverified: real windowing and sticky components showed no paint/hit-test offset in two clean Chromium controls; affected Safari hardware was unavailable.
7229.proposedFix: First capture the failing state in affected Safari, then compare anchoring and fully realized-list controls; do not ship a speculative workaround.
7229.caveats: No Safari/macOS trackpad reproduction. Verification covers the bounded negative control, not the absence of a Safari bug. Repro code is embedded inline under the public report repository's artifact rules.
